years.1781: Born in Chhapaiya on Ram Navami. On Ashadh vad 7 Sage Markandey names him Hari, Krishna and Harikrishna; the village calls him Ghanshyam. As an infant he survives an attack by the demon Kalidatt.
years.1782: Infancy in Chhapaiya with Dharmadev, Bhaktimata and his elder brother Rampratapbhai.
years.1783: Early childhood in Chhapaiya. Tradition records his love of sitting near sadhus and listening to katha.
years.1784: Chaul sanskar (first haircut) at about age 3. During the ceremony the demon Kalidatt attacks Chhapaiya and is destroyed. The family moves to Ayodhya around this time.
years.1785: Childhood in Ayodhya: daily bath in the Saryu and darshan at the mandirs.
years.1786: Begins studying the scriptures at about age 5 with his father Dharmadev as his teacher.
years.1787: Childhood in Ayodhya; learning to read and write.
years.1788: Childhood in Ayodhya; begins learning scripture from his father.
years.1789: Yagnopavit (sacred thread) at age 8. Soon after, he leaves home for pilgrimage; his uncle Vishram Mama follows him and persuades him to come back.
years.1790: Scriptural study. At about age 10 he speaks in a scholars' assembly at Kashi in support of Vishishtadvait.
years.1791: Bhaktimata passes away in Kartik, V.S. 1848, when Ghanshyam is 10 years and 7 months old.
years.1792: Dharmadev passes away about 7 months after Bhaktimata. On Ashadh sud 10 Ghanshyam leaves home as Nilkanth Varni and walks north through Kedarnath to Badrinath.
years.1793: Returns to Badrinath in mid-April after the winter at Manasarovar. Monsoon austerities at Pulhashram for four months; the Sun god gives him darshan.
years.1794: Nepal: King Mahadatt's court at Butol. Learns Ashtang yoga from Gopal Yogi for about a year.
years.1795: After about a year learning yoga with Gopal Yogi, performs his last rites. Reaches Kathmandu in December 1795 and meets King Rana Bahadur Shah.
years.1796: Jagannathpuri, where he stays about a year.
years.1797: South India: Venkatadri, Shivkanchi and Shrirangam.
years.1798: Setubandh Rameshwaram and Kanyakumari; serves the sick sadhu Sevakram. Then north through Pandharpur and Nashik.
years.1799: Enters Gujarat and Saurashtra; arrives at Loj on Shravan vad 6. Lives in the ashram doing seva and teaching yoga.
years.1800: Writes to Ramanand Swami on Falgun vad 5. Meets him at Piplana in Jeth and takes diksha on Prabodhini Ekadashi as Sahajanand Swami.
years.1801: Installed as successor at Jetpur. Ramanand Swami passes away at Faneni.
years.1802: Gives the Swaminarayan mantra at Faneni. Samadhi spreads among followers; he travels widely through Saurashtra.
years.1803: Travels through Saurashtra and Kutch, holding assemblies and initiating sadhus.
years.1804: Comes to Gadhada for the first time on Magshar sud 11, V.S. 1861, at Abhel Khachar's invitation.
years.1805: Gadhada becomes a regular base; Dada Khachar is about 4 years old.
years.1806: Travels and assemblies; Gadhada becomes a regular base. In Kartik of V.S. 1863, under the harmo tree in Bhaktibag, Gadhada, he dictates a letter on geography and astronomy, later included in the Vachanamrut as Bhugol-Khagol.
years.1807: Travels; non-violent yagnas and teaching against animal sacrifice.
years.1809: Holds his first major non-violent yagna at Jetalpur near Ahmedabad, attended by priests from as far as Benares.
years.1810: Mahayagna at Dabhan; diksha of Gunatitanand Swami.
years.1811: Travels; work against female infanticide and sati.
years.1812: Travels; work against female infanticide continues.
years.1813: Great famine in Kathiawad. He carries grain on horseback at night to families too proud to beg, and opens alms houses.
years.1814: Travels and assemblies; Gadhada becomes his main home.
years.1815: Life centred on Gadhada, with journeys for festivals.
years.1816: Life centred on Gadhada, with journeys for festivals.
years.1817: Life centred on Gadhada, with journeys for festivals.
years.1818: Around this time his brothers Rampratapbhai and Ichchharambhai are found near Ayodhya and reunited with him at Vadtal after about 26 years.
years.1819: The Vachanamrut record begins on Magshar sud 4 in Gadhada.
years.1820: Most heavily recorded year: discourses in Gadhada, Sarangpur, Kariyani and Loya.
years.1822: Installs Nar Narayan Dev in Ahmedabad, the first mandir.
years.1824: Installs Lakshmi Narayan Dev at Vadtal.
years.1826: Writes the Shikshapatri; Dholera mandir; appoints the two Acharyas.
years.1828: Junagadh mandir; Gopinathji installed at Gadhada.
years.1829: The last recorded Vachanamrut, Gadhada III-39, on Ashadh sud 10.
years.1830: Meets Sir John Malcolm at Rajkot. Antardhan at Gadhada on Jeth sud 10.

events.subtitle: Premvati, daughter of Krishnasharma and Bhagyavati
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 11
log: Bhaktimata is born at moonrise on Kartik purnima, a Wednesday, under Krittika nakshatra.

events.title: Birth of Ghanshyam
events.subtitle: Ram Navami
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline
log: Chhapaiya celebrates Ram Navami; Dharmadev and Bhaktimata keep the fast
Katha and bhajan of Shri Ram's birth in the village
Ghanshyam is born to Bhaktimata in Dharmadev's home
Relatives and villagers gather; tradition says the night was filled with unusual peace and joy

events.title: Annaprashan
events.subtitle: First solid food for Ghanshyam
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 18
log: Prakaran 18 tells, in order, the naamkaran by Markandey muni (names Hari, Krishna and Harikrishna; no day given), then the ear-piercing and this annaprashan.
Ghanshyam is given his first solid food. A sword, a gold coin and a book are placed before him, and he puts his hand on the book.

events.title: Karnavedh (ear-piercing)
events.subtitle: In the seventh month, on a Thursday purnima
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 18
log: Ghanshyam's ears are pierced and he is dressed in gold ornaments.

events.title: Chaul (first haircut)
events.subtitle: In his third year
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 19
log: In his third year, on Jeth vad 5, the family performs Ghanshyam's first haircut with a large celebration.

events.title: Upanayan (sacred thread)
events.subtitle: In his eighth year
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 22
log: The astrologers pick Maha sud 10 in Ghanshyam's eighth year for his upanayan.

events.title: Bhaktimata falls ill
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 24
log: Bhaktimata develops a fever.

events.title: Bhaktimata leaves her body
events.subtitle: After hearing the Harigita from Ghanshyam
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 24
log: On Saturday morning, with her mind fixed on Shri Krishna's murti, Premvati leaves her body and attains a divine form.

events.title: Leaves home as Nilkanth Varni
events.subtitle: Age 11
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline; SKSST timeline
log: Rises while the household sleeps; takes a deerskin, kaupin, palash staff, rosary, water pot, Balmukund idol and a gutka of scriptures
Walks out of the family home in Ayodhya without telling anyone
Goes to the Saryu, swims out into the flooded river and emerges far downstream, aged 11 years, 3 months and 1 day
Walks north toward the Himalayas; begins a seven-year pilgrimage

events.title: Diwali at Badrinath
events.subtitle: Nilkanth Varni, age 11
events.src: Traditional account (dates it mid-October 1792)
log: Arrives at Badrinath after crossing the mountains from Kedarnath
The Badrinath priest recognises something divine in him and offers him prasad
The mandir closes for six months of snow; he goes on alone toward Manasarovar
The Bhaktachintamani does not name Badrinath on this route (prakarans 28–30). Kept as a traditional account at Hardik's request, 10 Nov 2026.

events.title: Arrives at Loj
events.subtitle: End of the forest pilgrimage
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline
log: Reaches the step-well outside Loj and bathes
Sukhanand, a young sadhu filling water, sees him and invites him to the ashram
Meets Muktanand Swami, who leads the ashram while Ramanand Swami is in Bhuj
Asks his five spiritual questions; Muktanand Swami answers them and he decides to stay

events.title: Letter to Ramanand Swami
events.src: swaminarayan.nu
log: Nilkanth Varni writes a personal letter to Ramanand Swami in Bhuj
Asks him to return to Loj as soon as possible so he may have darshan

events.title: First meeting with Ramanand Swami
events.src: swaminarayan.nu; SKSST timeline; Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 44
log: After about 9 months at Loj, a message comes through the devotee Kunverjibhai asking Nilkanth, Muktanand Swami and others to come to Piplana
They arrive at the house of Narsinh Mehta, where Ramanand Swami is staying after returning from Bhuj
Ramanand Swami rises and embraces Nilkanth Varni
The Bhaktachintamani (prakaran 44) gives Jeth vad 12: "જ્યેષ્ઠ વદી બારશને દન, કર્યું સહુએ સ્વામીનું દર્શન".

events.title: Bhagvati diksha
events.subtitle: Prabodhini Ekadashi
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline
log: He had met Ramanand Swami at Piplana and waited nearly a year for diksha
Ramanand Swami gives Nilkanth Varni bhagvati diksha in Piplana
Receives two names: Sahajanand Swami and Narayan Muni
Ekadashi fast and assembly with sadhus and devotees

events.title: Installed as successor
events.subtitle: Prabodhini Ekadashi
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline ; Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakarans 46–47
log: Ramanand Swami seats the 20-year-old Sahajanand Swami on the gadi in Jetpur
Sadhus and devotees accept him as head of the Uddhav Sampradaya
He asks two boons: to bear devotees' suffering himself, and that no devotee go without food or clothes
The Bhaktachintamani (prakarans 46–47): Ramanand Swami handed over the dhuri at Jetpur and then went to Faneni.

events.title: Ramanand Swami passes away
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut ; Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 47
log: Ramanand Swami leaves his body at Faneni
Sahajanand Swami leads the final rites and the period of mourning
The Bhaktachintamani (prakaran 47) gives Magshar sud 13, a Thursday ("વાર દેવગુરુ"), so Thursday 17 December 1801; sud 13 began that day. Shri Swaminarayanam lists sud 13 against 18 December.

events.title: The Swaminarayan mantra
events.subtitle: Fourteenth-day assembly
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline; swaminarayan.nu
log: Assembly on the 14th day after Ramanand Swami's death
Gives the new mantra "Swaminarayan" and asks everyone to chant it
Shitaldas, a Bihari pandit who had come to meet Ramanand Swami, chants the mantra, enters samadhi and asks for diksha; he is named Vyapakanand Swami
Devotees chanting the mantra enter samadhi; from now he is called Shri Swaminarayan

events.title: Vasant Panchami at Shekhpat
events.subtitle: At Lalji Suthar's house; Lalji later becomes Nishkulanand Swami
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 54–55 (introduction)
log: Shri Hari celebrates Vasant Panchami with saints and devotees at Lalji Suthar's house in Shekhpat, then goes on to Adhoi, where he initiates Lalji as Nishkulanand.

events.title: First arrival in Gadhada
events.src: SKSST timeline
log: Abhel Khachar, ruler of Gadhada, meets him at Kariyani and invites him to Gadhada
Abhel Khachar receives him and asks him to stay with the family
Abhel Khachar gives over his wealth and darbar before passing away; Gadhada becomes his home for most of his life

events.title: Recovers from illness at Agatrai
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: Shri Hari falls seriously ill at Agatrai and, out of compassion for his devotees, keeps his body.

events.title: Mahayagna at Dabhan
events.subtitle: Diksha of Gunatitanand Swami
events.src: Traditional account
log: Non-violent mahayagna at Dabhan, attended by thousands
Gives bhagvati diksha to Mulji Jani, naming him Gunatitanand Swami, with other sadhus

events.title: Recovers from illness at Jalia
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: Shri Hari recovers from an illness at Jalia.

events.title: Recovers from illness at Gadhada
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: Shri Hari recovers from an illness at Gadhada.

events.title: Arrives at Jetalpur for the Ahmedabad pratishtha
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 89
log: Shri Hari reaches Jetalpur on Maha vad 10. The next day he goes on to Ahmedabad (Shrinagar) for the murti pratishtha of Shri NarNarayan Dev.

events.title: First mandir: Nar Narayan Dev
events.subtitle: Murti pratishtha, Ahmedabad
events.src: Traditional account; mandir records
log: Vedic rites for the installation
Installs the murtis of Nar Narayan Dev in the new Ahmedabad mandir, his first
Feast and celebration with sadhus and devotees

events.title: Recovers from illness at Dholka
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: Shri Hari recovers from an illness at Dholka.

events.title: Recovers from illness at Panchala
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: On Ramnavmi Shri Hari recovers from an illness at Panchala.

events.title: Shri NarNarayan Dev installed at Bhuj
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 90
log: At an auspicious muhurt, Shri NarNarayan Dev is seated in the Bhuj mandir. Shri Hari then returns to Gadhada.

events.title: Lakshmi Narayan Dev installed
events.subtitle: Murti pratishtha, Vadtal
events.src: Traditional account; mandir records
log: Vedic rites at the new Vadtal mandir
Installs Lakshmi Narayan Dev; also places his own image, Harikrishna Maharaj, in the mandir
Large festival with thousands of devotees

events.title: Meeting with Bishop Heber
events.src: Reginald Heber, Narrative of a Journey through the Upper Provinces of India (1828)
log: Rides to Nadiad with a large escort of horsemen
Meets Reginald Heber, Anglican Bishop of Calcutta; they speak about God, dharma and his reforms
Heber later records the meeting in his journal and praises the moral change among followers

events.title: The Shikshapatri
events.subtitle: Vasant Panchami
events.src: Shikshapatri, closing verses; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline
log: Vasant Panchami celebration in Vadtal
Completes the Shikshapatri: 212 Sanskrit verses of conduct for all followers
Asks that it be read daily and honoured as his own form

events.title: Murti pratishtha at Dholera
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 97
log: Shri Hari comes to Dholera with the sangh and saints, by way of Pipli, to install the murtis.

events.title: Two Acharyas appointed
events.subtitle: Prabodhini Ekadashi
events.src: Traditional account; Desh Vibhag no Lekh
log: Adopts his nephews Ayodhyaprasadji and Raghuvirji
Appoints Ayodhyaprasadji to the Nar Narayan Dev Gadi, Ahmedabad, and Raghuvirji to the Lakshmi Narayan Dev Gadi, Vadtal

events.title: Gopinathji installed
events.subtitle: Murti pratishtha, Gadhada
events.src: Traditional account; mandir records
log: Installs Gopinathji in the Gadhada mandir, built on land given by Dada Khachar's family
He had carried stones for its construction himself

events.title: Final illness begins
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 161
log: Shri Hari falls ill, intending to return to his abode.

events.title: Meeting with Sir John Malcolm
events.src: Traditional account; Bodleian Library manuscript
log: Meets the Governor of Bombay, Sir John Malcolm, at Rajkot
They discuss peace and order in Saurashtra
Gives him a copy of the Shikshapatri, now held in the Bodleian Library, Oxford

events.title: Antardhan
events.subtitle: Return to Akshardham
events.src: Traditional account: Harililamrut, Bhaktachintamani; swaminarayanbhagwan.org timeline; SKSST timeline
log: He had forewarned his sadhus and devotees that he would leave
Tells Gopalanand Swami of his intention; places the hands of both Acharyas in Gopalanand Swami's care
Calls an assembly of sadhus and devotees; says he will remain present through his murtis, scriptures, Acharyas and sadhus, and asks no one to harm themselves
Sits with senior sadhus, closes his eyes and leaves his body, aged 49 years, 2 months and 1 day

events.title: Bhaktachintamani completed
events.subtitle: Nishkulanand Swami finishes the granth, 164 prakarans
events.src: Bhaktachintamani (Nishkulanand Swami), Bhuj ed. VS 2068, prakaran 164
log: On Thursday, at Gadhada on the bank of the Unmatta Ganga (Ghela), Nishkulanand Swami completes the Bhaktachintamani.

scenes.gu: સર જોન માલ્કમ સાથે મુલાકાત · રાજકોટ
